# Homes247.in

> > India's leading real estate portal for property search, ratings, reviews, and expert services across major cities including Bangalore, Delhi, and Goa.

Homes247.in is a comprehensive proptech platform offering property listings, project reviews, walkthrough videos, and expert real estate services. The portal specializes in residential and commercial properties across India, with a strong focus on Bangalore neighborhoods like Sarjapur Road, Kasavanahalli, Jakkur, and Devanahalli, featuring projects from leading developers.
